function: () => { const region = document.querySelector("[aria-roledescription=carousel]"); if (!region) return "no carousel"; const viewport = region.querySelector(".overflow-hidden"); const track = viewport.firstElementChild; const cards = track.children; const cs = getComputedStyle(track); return JSON.stringify({ trackWidth: track.offsetWidth, trackStyleWidth: cs.width, viewportWidth: viewport.offsetWidth, cardCount: cards.length, firstCardWidth: cards[0].offsetWidth, firstCardFlex: getComputedStyle(cards[0]).flexBasis, transform: getComputedStyle(track).transform, viewportClass: viewport.className }, null, 2); }
